Read input: delay_module_combined.v · Open raw
module delay_module (
    input [31:0] addr,
    input clk,
    input [31:0] datain,
    output [31:0] dataout,
    input debug,
    input enb,
    input [3:0] web
);
  // Delay logic example
  reg [31:0] delay_memory [0:255];
  reg [31:0] delayed_data;
  
  assign dataout = delayed_data;
  
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (enb) begin
      if (web)
        delay_memory[addr] <= datain;
      delayed_data <= delay_memory[addr];
    end
  end
endmodule
